answer: Reaching eligibility takes 36 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. The opal register is checked at draw time, ledge lists the eligible set, and mesa seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 36 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 463 account operation therefore ties up 18 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
